classes.name: sign:surface_soiling
classes.definition: Vùng có chất bẩn hoặc xơ/bụi nhìn thấy; không suy thiết bị hỏng.
positivePrompts: a photo of a dirty dusty surface
a photo of dust buildup on an air filter
a photo of a muddy dirty floor
negativePrompts: a photo of a clean surface
a photo of a clean floor
a photo of a new clean air filter

classes.name: sign:stain_or_discoloration
classes.definition: Vùng đổi màu nhìn thấy; không kết luận ướt hoặc nguồn rò.
positivePrompts: a photo of a stained wall
a photo of a stained dirty floor
a photo of water stains on a ceiling
negativePrompts: a photo of a clean wall
a photo of a clean floor
a photo of plain tiles

classes.name: sign:crack
classes.definition: Đường nứt trên vật liệu, phân biệt mạch ghép và họa tiết.
positivePrompts: a photo of a cracked wall
a photo of a crack in plaster
negativePrompts: a photo of an intact wall
a photo of tile joints
a photo of scratched paint

classes.name: sign:mold_like_growth
classes.definition: Mảng bám có hình dạng phù hợp; không xác định loài nấm hoặc độc tính.
positivePrompts: a photo of mold growth on a wall
a photo of green algae on a wall
negativePrompts: a photo of a clean wall
a photo of a painted wall pattern
a photo of peeling paint

classes.name: sign:scorched_outlet
classes.definition: Khung bao ổ cắm có dấu cháy; không phải khung vết cháy nhỏ và không suy nguyên nhân.
positivePrompts: a photo of a burnt electrical outlet
a photo of a scorched power socket
negativePrompts: a photo of a clean intact electrical outlet
a photo of a new power outlet
a photo of a normal electrical switch

classes.name: sign:socket_damage_or_displacement
classes.displayNameVi: Ổ cắm hư hại/lệch khỏi mặt lắp
classes.definition: Khung bao ổ cắm có hư hại hoặc tách lệch nhìn thấy; không kết luận đấu dây sai.
positivePrompts: a photo of a broken electrical outlet
a photo of a loose power socket detached from a wall
negativePrompts: a photo of an intact electrical outlet
a photo of a new power socket

classes.name: sign:exposed_conductor
classes.definition: Đoạn lõi dây không có vỏ bọc nhìn thấy; có thể đang lắp đặt, chưa kết luận nguy hiểm hay hỏng.
positivePrompts: a photo of exposed copper wires
a photo of electrical cable with damaged insulation
negativePrompts: a photo of insulated electrical cable
a photo of a power plug
a photo of a rope

classes.name: sign:visible_water
classes.definition: Nước/tia nước/vũng nước trong vùng nguồn gán nhãn; không tự kết luận ống vỡ hoặc nguồn rò.
positivePrompts: a photo of water spraying from a pipe
a photo of a water puddle
a photo of a leaking pipe
negativePrompts: a photo of a dry road
a photo of a dry pipe
a photo of a dry wall

classes.name: sign:peeling_surface
classes.definition: Vùng bong hoặc tróc lớp phủ nhìn thấy; không suy nguyên nhân ẩm.
positivePrompts: a photo of peeling paint
a photo of flaking wall paint
negativePrompts: a photo of an intact painted wall
a photo of a wallpaper pattern
a photo of a clean baseboard

classes.name: sign:broken_part
classes.definition: Khung bao vùng vật liệu gãy/vỡ hoặc mất phần nhìn thấy; không bao toàn thiết bị nguyên vẹn.
positivePrompts: a photo of broken tiles
a photo of shattered window glass
a photo of a damaged ceiling with a hole
negativePrompts: a photo of intact tiles
a photo of an intact glass window
a photo of an intact ceiling

notes: No underlying fault diagnoses inferred from single photos.
Source classes ignored for training are explicitly excluded, not negatives.
New label names describe visible evidence and preserve source geometry semantics.
Plant/gardening dataset not present in downloaded archives.
AI alignment is heuristic, not verification or calibrated probability.
